what: Aborted run: tt-metal v0.77.0 optimizer set WITHOUT warmup. Kept as evidence.
why_it_exists: Launched with --warmup-frac 0.02 believing warmup was active. It was not: main() resolved the default `constant` schedule to lr_fn = None, so set_lr was never called and the ramp never happened. Killed at ~6,290 of 10,764 steps once the curve made the problem obvious.
config_as_RUN: beta2 0.95 + weight_decay_skip_1d, NO warmup, constant 3e-4 from step 0

comparison_at_matched_steps.note: WITHDRAWN. This run used artifacts/tokens; the dialogue baseline used tokens-v4. The deltas below are between different corpora and mean nothing about the optimizer.

reading: WITHDRAWN -- see CORRECTION_2026-08-19. The original reading blamed a corpus difference on the optimizer.
what_this_does_NOT_establish: That beta2 0.95 is bad for this model, or that weight_decay_skip_1d is. Both were changed together and neither was isolated. It establishes only that this combination, without warmup, trains materially worse than the baseline.
superseded_by: The relaunched run with warmup verified live in the banner.

CORRECTION_2026-08-19.what_was_wrong: This file compared its curve against artifacts/checkpoints-1024-dialogue and reported a ~1.3 nat gap as if the optimizer caused it. It did not. This run trained on artifacts/tokens (built 2026-08-14), the DEFAULT --tokens-dir, while the dialogue baseline trained on artifacts/tokens-v4 (built 2026-08-18 07:54, seven minutes before its first checkpoint). Different corpus, different validation set, different loss scale.
CORRECTION_2026-08-19.so_the_comparison_is_withdrawn: Every dialogue-baseline delta in this file is void. The numbers were measured; what they were measured against was wrong.
CORRECTION_2026-08-19.also_wrong: The note below claiming the corpus grew 350,964,883 -> 353,495,970 and therefore invalidated ts10-b-s5489 as a baseline. Those are tokens-lowts and tokens respectively, and NEITHER is the dialogue corpus. The reasoning happened to reach a correct conclusion (ts10-b is not a valid baseline) from a wrong premise.
CORRECTION_2026-08-19.what_survives: The comparison between this run and the warmup-enabled rerun on the SAME wrong corpus: 5.8969 vs 5.9031 at step 1000. Both trained on artifacts/tokens, so that one is valid, and it shows 2% linear warmup makes no measurable difference to this run.
CORRECTION_2026-08-19.what_is_still_untested: beta2 0.95 and weight_decay_skip_1d. No valid measurement of either exists yet.
CORRECTION_2026-08-19.how_it_happened: train/run.py defaults --tokens-dir to artifacts/tokens. I never passed it, twice, and never checked what the baseline had used before quoting a delta against it.
